fields.DESCRIPTION: Bring a burst of colours wherever you go with the Garden Bliss Handcrafted Sling Bag. Featuring a lively floral pattern on a soothing teal base, this bag beautifully balances vibrancy with elegance. Accented with rich brown faux leather straps and golden hardware, it’s perfect for casual outings, festive gatherings, or as a statement accessory to uplift any outfit. Spacious, stylish, and lightweight — a true blend of fashion and function.
